runtimeExpectationExpressions.text:
expect(
			verifyAuthenticationResponse(
				{ ...config, userVerification: "required" },
				response,
				validCredential,
				challengeStore,
			),
		).rejects.toMatchObject({ code: "user_verification_not_verified" })

expect(
			verifyAuthenticationResponse(
				{ ...config, userVerification: "required" },
				response,
				validCredential,
				challengeStore,
			),
		).resolves.toMatchObject({ credentialId: validCredential.id })

expect(
			verifyAuthenticationResponse(
				config,
				response,
				{ ...validCredential, counter: 1 },
				challengeStore,
			),
		).rejects.toMatchObject({ code: "invalid_signature_counter" })

expect(
			verifyAuthenticationResponse(
				{ ...config, userVerification: "required" },
				response,
				validCredential,
				atomicStore,
				approvalContext,
			),
		).resolves.toMatchObject({ challengeContext: { intentId: "intent_1" } })

expect(
			verifyAuthenticationResponse(
				{ ...config, userVerification: "required" },
				response,
				validCredential,
				atomicStore,
				approvalContext,
			),
		).rejects.toMatchObject({ code: "context_binding_mismatch" })

boundaries: Actual Kit HTTP and canonical local database replace Astro cookie/context fixtures.
Source cookie path /_emdash/ becomes native app base path; divergent path assertion gets zero source credit.
Other nonce/status/security expectations retain source results; source route implementation is not vendored.
Actual guarded Kit HTTP with canonical session revocation replaces the Astro session stub.
302 and Location=/blog, or 200 and Location=null for tab/LF/CR slashes retain the four unique source expectations.

sourceExecution.result: 34 original parameterized source cases pass against ten byte-verified immutable source files, plus three original supplemental setup-email reference probes with zero copied source credit.

limitations: Typed-context algorithms are tested but production has no atomic typed-context store/endpoint.
Astro session-driver storage/renewal and full setup site/seed wizard are unported.
The copied runtime suites do not prove deployed Cloudflare, full auth-product parity or first-party credential management.
